sentences.japanese: 我が党の党首は他の党首達と会見し、その問題について話をした。
sentences.english: The leader of our party met with the other leaders and talked about the problem.

sentences.japanese: 我が党にもようやく、誇りをもって出せる候補者ができた。
sentences.english: Our party finally had a candidate we could put forward with pride.

sentences.japanese: その党は総選挙で圧勝した。
sentences.english: The party won a sweeping victory at the general election.

sentences.japanese: その党は主に働く女性から成り立っている。
sentences.english: The party is mainly made up of working women.

sentences.japanese: その党は急激にのびた。
